title: Driver App
tagline: Everything a driver logs, from pickup to office return.

features.title: Secure Driver Login
features.description: Every action in the system is tied to a verified driver identity and a daily assigned route.

features.title: Pickup Logging
features.description: Facility, team, item type, and quantity recorded in seconds, with a timestamped pickup photo.

features.title: Delivery Photo Proof
features.description: Delivery location, team, and condition logged with photo proof. No signatures required.

features.title: Quick Incident Reporting
features.description: Wrong facility, wrong quantity, damage, closure, or delay — flagged in one tap from the field.

features.title: Daily Dashboard
features.description: Today's pickups, deliveries, tray and bin counts, completed routes, and open issues at a glance.

title: Rep Portal
tagline: Real-time visibility for the team receiving your instruments.

features.title: Live Status Board
features.description: Picked up, in transit, and delivered — with quantities, facility, team, and photo proof in real time.

features.title: Item Detail View
features.description: Pickup and delivery photos, quantities, timestamps, and driver information for any tray or bin.

features.title: Ready for Office Pickup
features.description: One tap notifies dispatch, opens a new driver route, and creates a timestamped pickup record.

features.title: Route History
features.description: A complete audit trail from pickup to delivery to office return, with photos and timestamps attached.

features.title: Compliance Reports
features.description: Chain-of-custody logs, photo proof logs, movement logs, delivery times, and incident logs, exportable on demand.
